summary: Full backend (16 pytest tests, all pass) + frontend E2E (Playwright) of the virtual trucking app. Every requested feature works: login/error/protected redirect, dashboard KPIs and 7 charts, trucks CRUD and duplicate-number toast, fuel gallons auto-fill from the tank size with total/MPG preview, backend-computed total/mpg and updated KPIs, expenses CRUD with category add/rename/remove and filter, the load-to-income link (create/update/delete), the loads On Time/Late filter and KPIs, the drivers performance table and charts, inspections with fine fields shown only for non-Passed results plus filters and fines-by-reason, and adding/removing test data (user rows kept). Only small UI/UX issues found.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout: 6+ wrong attempts all return 401 with no lockout or throttling (playbook item 4).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True. Low risk because auth uses a Bearer token, but explicit origins are recommended.

ui_bugs.issue: If the category being filtered is deleted, the <select> falls back to showing 'All categories' but catFilter state still holds the deleted id, so the table shows '0 records'. Reset catFilter to 'all' when the selected category is removed.
api.delete has no try/catch, so a failed delete gives no error toast (unhandled promise).

issues: X-axis tick labels overlap ('$8,500.00$17,000.00'). Use compact currency ticks ($8.5k) or fewer ticks.
The last X-axis tick ('8.00') is clipped at the right edge. Add right margin.
Date fields use the browser's native date picker instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover.
KPIs (Loads/On time/Late) always show all-data totals even when the Late/On Time filter is active (may be intended).

action_items: Reset expenses catFilter to 'all' when the selected category is deleted
Wrap CategoryManager remove() in try/catch with an error toast
Fix overlapping and clipped X-axis ticks on the driver revenue and MPG bar charts
Optional: replace native date inputs with the shadcn Calendar; add login brute-force lockout; set explicit CORS origins
critical_code_review_comments: The is_test flag on a load is copied to its linked income on insert only, so editing works. However, seed_test_data reuses existing trucks named T-101..106 even if the user created them (is_test=0), which mixes sample fuel/loads onto user trucks. This is an edge case.
Sync endpoints use sqlite3 in def handlers (threadpool), which is acceptable for SQLite.
sync_load_income sets income.date to '' when a load has no due or delivered date. These rows are then left out of the monthly chart (m != '') but still count in totals.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of functional flows (minor UI issues listed)

test_credentials: owner / trucker123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). bcrypt hash starts with $2b$; httpOnly Secure SameSite=None cookie is set on login.
seed_data_creation: Sample data was removed and re-seeded via /api/test-data. All UI/pytest-created records (UI-900 truck, its fuel record, the UI inspection and the UI expense) were cleaned up. The DB now has sample data only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_fleet_api.py. TestZTestData reseeds sample data at the end. Shadcn select options have data-testid input-{field}-option-{id}. Category chips: use 'div.rounded-full[data-testid^=category-]' (the category-manager panel also matches the category- prefix). The category delete uses window.confirm, so accept the dialog in Playwright.
